prompt_used: You are given an image. Write a detailed natural language prompt that could have been used to generate this image. Focus on the most salient and unique visual elements such as the subjects, their clothing, expressions, actions, background, and composition. Describe the color palette, lighting, and overall style, including any cinematic or artistic qualities like camera angle, depth of field, or motion. Make the description as accurate and faithful to the image as possible. If small details are uncertain or ambiguous, omit them and prioritize capturing the overall scene, mood, and visual impression. The final prompt should be coherent, evocative, written as if by an expert visual artist or filmmaker recreating the exact scene.
caption: A close-up, macro shot of an elegant analog clock face, focusing tightly on the intersection of the gold hour and minute hands. The hands are positioned around 7:25, casting a soft, diffused shadow onto the smooth, matte white clock face. The numbers and minute markers are finely printed in black, with only the numbers 7 and 8 partially visible at the edge of the frame, emphasizing the passage of time. The lighting is gentle and natural, creating subtle highlights on the metallic surfaces and a calm, contemplative mood. The composition is minimalist, with a shallow depth of field that blurs the background and draws attention to the crisp details of the clock hands and their central pivot. The overall style is clean and modern, evoking a sense of quiet precision and the fleeting nature of moments.
